name: Sparse Chunk (Brick) Storage
definition: A voxel grid storage scheme that replaces a dense layer box with a sparse map of fixed-size chunks to decouple resolution from memory usage. It uses a hash map to store only non-empty chunks, where an absent key implies an empty chunk.
summary: Sparse Chunk Storage uses a hash map of 16³ chunks to decouple resolution from memory, differing from bit-packed arrays by coarser granularity and from octrees by using arithmetic addressing instead of tree traversal.
